It achieves this by checking if childNodes is set to EMPTY_NODES and, if so, assigns it a new ArrayList with an initial capacity of 4.  
At line 7, it calls setSiblingIndex(). setSiblingIndex()'s intention is The method's primary purpose is to assign a new value to the siblingIndex attribute. It achieves this by directly setting the siblingIndex field to the provided integer parameter.
